#@ \trusted
    #@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures 1 == 1
    #@ assigns \nothing
    def has_continue(stmts: List[Dict[str, Any]]) -> bool:
        n = len(stmts)
        i = 0
        result = 0
        #@ loop invariant 0 <= i and i <= n
        #@ loop invariant result == 0 or result == 1
        #@ loop variant n - i
        while i < n:
            stmt = stmts[i]
            if stmt["stmt"] == "Continue":
                result = 1
                i = n
            elif stmt["stmt"] == "If":
                if (IRScanner.has_continue(stmt.get("body", [])) or
                        IRScanner.has_continue(stmt.get("orelse", []))):
                    result = 1
                    i = n
                else:
                    i += 1
            else:
                i += 1
        return result == 1
